jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Data & Integration
jobs.description:
Build bold. Deliver impact. Win together.

At General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, we’re not just engineering technology — we’re shaping the future of defence and security. Our teams design and deliver advanced, mission-critical solutions that enhance national security, strengthen communities, and protect the people we serve.

If you’re looking for meaningful work that contributes to a safer, more secure world, you’ll find purpose here. Every day, your skills will directly impact programs that matter.

Job Description

Reporting to the Chief Digital and Information Officer (CDIO), the Director, Enterprise Data & Integration is responsible for establishing and maturing the organization's enterprise data capability. This includes developing the enterprise data strategy, architecture, governance framework, integration standards, and technology roadmap required to support operational excellence, analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.

The Director will help build and lead a small Data Engineering team and work across business and technology functions to transform fragmented, project-based data initiatives into a scalable, governed, and sustainable enterprise capability. This role is accountable for ensuring enterprise data is managed, integrated, and leveraged as a strategic asset across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Data Strategy & Capability Development

Develop and maintain the enterprise data strategy, roadmap, operating model, and target-state architecture aligned with business priorities.
Establish and mature enterprise data capabilities spanning architecture, governance, integration, engineering standards, and information management practices.
Partner with business and technology leaders to enable data-driven decision-making, analytics, automation, and AI readiness.

Data Architecture, Governance & Integration

Define and govern enterprise data architecture, integration architecture, information management standards, and reference models.
Establish scalable approaches for APIs, MuleSoft integration services, event-driven architecture, data pipelines, metadata, lineage, master/reference data, and data quality.
Ensure enterprise data solutions are secure, compliant, resilient, and aligned with enterprise architecture principles.

Platforms, Technology & Innovation

Provide strategic leadership for enterprise data platforms, integration technologies, analytics environments, and AI-enabling capabilities.
Evaluate technologies, vendors, and strategic investments to ensure alignment with business objectives, architecture standards, and long-term sustainability.
Drive modernization, simplification, and standardization across the enterprise data and integration landscape.

Leadership & Delivery Enablement

Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to the Data Engineering team while fostering strong engineering and operational practices.
Support the planning, prioritization, and successful delivery of enterprise data and integration initiatives.
Build strong partnerships across business units, cybersecurity, infrastructure, applications, enterprise architecture, and external partners.

Governance & Continuous Improvement

Establish governance processes, architecture reviews, standards, and decision-making frameworks for enterprise data and integration solutions.
Identify and reduce technical debt, platform fragmentation, unmanaged data movement, and point-to-point integrations.
Promote reuse, consistency, and continuous improvement across enterprise data platforms, services, and integration capabilities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.
10+ years of experience in enterprise data architecture, integration architecture, data engineering, enterprise architecture, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated experience developing enterprise data strategies, governance frameworks, architecture standards, and technology roadmaps.
Experience leading technical teams and influencing senior business and technology stakeholders.
Strong understanding of enterprise data management, integration, governance, analytics, cloud platforms, security, and information management principles.
Experience working with or familiarity with AI/ML models

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing and governing enterprise integration capabilities using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
, including API-led connectivity, reusable integration services, event-driven architectures, and integration governance.
Experience with modern enterprise data platforms including Snowflake
, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Purview, AWS data services, or comparable technologies.
Experience supporting enterprise analytics, reporting, AI/ML, automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
Familiarity with TOGAF, DAMA-DMBOK, COBIT, ITIL, or comparable architecture and governance frameworks.

It is a requirement that General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada be registered with the Canadian Controlled Goods Program and that all of its workforce be security assessed. Successful applicants must meet all applicable security requirements, including but not limited to the ability to obtain and maintain a Canadian government security clearance. Applicants may be required to meet additional security requirements in order to gain access to technical data, classified areas, or information that is subject to international regulations. You must be eligible to work in Canada.

Additional Information

The hiring range for this position is $150,000-$200,000. This role is eligible for a management incentive plan. Our goal is to provide a fair and competitive offer based on an assessment of internal equity and your qualifications, including:

Relevant experience
Technical and non-technical skills
Education and certifications

Benefits

As a full-time employee at General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada, you’ll enjoy a competitive total rewards package that supports your professional and personal well-being:

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and eligible dependents from day one (no cost), including flexible benefits options (HCSA) emergency travel insurance, and 24/7 virtual care services.
Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP), onsite fitness facilities, and employee resource groups.
Defined Contribution Pension Plan with employer contributions after 3 months, RRSP access from day one, and financial planning support.
Flexible time off including vacation, holidays, parental leaves with top-up options, sick leave, and disability programs.
Career development through learning platforms, educational assistance, mentoring, and reimbursement of professional memberships.
Additional perks such as employee discounts, free onsite parking, social clubs, and an annual scholarship program for employees’ children.

Why join us?

Purposeful Innovation:
You’ll work on innovations that genuinely make a difference. You’ll apply advanced thinking, design expertise, and practical problem-solving to help equip military and allied forces with leading-edge systems. You’ll be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in the defence sector, contributing to next-generation technologies in an environment that celebrates creativity, new ideas, and modern solutions.
Connection:
We believe people do their best work when they feel they belong, and their ideas can flourish. Different perspectives, experiences, and ways of thinking help us innovate and grow. Strong relationships with our teammates help us unite, overcome challenges, and deliver the world-class quality we’re known for. Here, we are committed to inclusivity and ensures every individual feels valued, respected, and empowered.
Challenging and Rewarding Career Pathways:
Your career path matters to us. From mentorship and regular check-ins with your leader to educational support, professional certifications, and continuous training, you’ll have the resources you need to thrive. We encourage internal mobility so you can explore different business areas, broaden your skillset, and expand your network. You’ll be working on high-profile, impactful projects that challenge your skills, expand your expertise, and allow you to both learn from mentors and guide others along the way.

Accommodation

If you require accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact Human Resources via recruitment@gd-ms.ca.

Closing Date

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive sufficient applications for the role. Therefore, if you are interested, please submit your application as early as possible.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Generative AI and Agentic AI Architecture
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job ID: 00070923031

Associate Director, Generative AI and Agentic AI Architecture

About The Role

As an Associate Director, Generative AI and Agentic AI Architecture, you will make an impact by shaping and delivering enterprise-scale Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions across strategic client accounts. You will be a valued member of Cognizant’s AI leadership team and work collaboratively with client executives, Sales, Presales, Delivery, Engineering, and Data Science teams.

In this highly visible role, you will combine hands-on AI architecture expertise with executive advisory, solution delivery, practice development, and technical leadership.

In This Role, You Will

Lead the strategy, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and multi-agent AI solutions across multiple client engagements.
Advise CXO-level stakeholders, facilitate executive workshops and AI maturity assessments, and translate complex AI capabilities into measurable business outcomes and adoption roadmaps.
Define scalable reference architectures, technical standards, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, observability, and governance for production AI systems integrated with enterprise applications, data platforms, and cloud environments.
Develop repeatable AI offerings, accelerators, reusable components, and intellectual property while supporting proposals, RFPs, solution estimates, and account growth opportunities.
Build and mentor high-performing teams of AI architects, engineers, and data scientists while promoting responsible AI, technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

Work model

We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in Canada. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you are engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

What You Need To Have To Be Considered

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, combined with extensive progressive experience in AI/ML architecture, consulting, and delivery leadership.
Proven experience architecting and delivering production-grade Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, and Agentic AI solutions using large language models, small language models, and orchestration frameworks.
Hands-on expertise with Python, model APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, agentic workflows, embedding models, vector databases, reranking, hybrid search, and retrieval architectures.
Experience integrating AI solutions with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, along with containerization, Kubernetes, CI/CD, MLOps, LLMOps, security, monitoring, and enterprise governance practices.
Strong client-facing leadership and executive communication skills, including experience advising senior stakeholders, leading complex AI engagements, developing proposals and statements of work, and managing globally distributed teams.

These will help you stand out

A PhD, MBA, or advanced credential in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or business management.
Published research, patents, open-source contributions, conference presentations, or recognized thought leadership in Generative AI, Agentic AI, natural language processing, or LLMOps.
Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Google Agent Development Kit, as well as AgentOps, model evaluation, and AI observability platforms.
Knowledge of responsible AI, enterprise data governance, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the EU AI Act, and emerging AI regulatory requirements.
Consulting experience within Financial Services, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Retail, Manufacturing, or Technology.

Salary And Other Compensation

Applicants will be accepted till 11/15/2026

Cognizant will only consider applicants for this position who are legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship.

Please note, this role cannot offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future*

The annual salary for this position will be in the range of $152,000 - $170,000 CAD depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans.

Benefits:
Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements:

Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off
401(k) plan and contributions
Long-term/Short-term Disability
Paid Parental Leave
Employee Stock Purchase Plan

Disclaimer:
The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Cognizant reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.title: Director, Application Development - Customer Digital
jobs.description:
Being part of Air Canada is to become part of an iconic Canadian symbol, recently ranked the best Airline in North America. Let your career take flight by joining our diverse and vibrant team at the leading edge of passenger aviation.

The Director of Application Development will lead the design, development, and delivery of some of our most critical customer digital applications and all our in-house cargo applications. Its customer application portfolio consists of aircanada.com’s content related applications (Content Management System (CMS) platform, Homepage), marketing digital assets (Offer Management, DNA) as well as Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM). Its cargo portfolio includes the cargo website (informational and transactional), the cargo distribution API, the cargo digital backend and all the cargo integrations, a portfolio that keeps growing with the new Cargo Management System implementation through the end of 2028.

This role will also be responsible for the Delivery COE and the Innovation COE for all the customer and cargo portfolios. The Delivery COE aims at harmonizing the delivery practice, KPIs, continuous improvements within the portfolio. The Innovation COE aims at improving our digital technology platforms, through continuous improvements (i.e., progressive AI adoption, Continuous Integration /Continuous Development (CI/CD) pipeline enhancements, etc) as well as disruptive innovations through POCs and partnership with Air Canada’s key technology vendors (i.e., transition to Mono Repo, introduction of a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) stack, etc.). This role is key to our digital transformation journey and will be pivotal in empowering the IDD organization to achieve its cost transformation and innovation goals.

This role will also focus on people leadership, including talent acquisition, training, performance management, and fostering a high-performing team culture.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy
Provide strategic and hands-on leadership for teams building the future marketing and content technology landscape for Air Canada
Lead the cargo deliver teams towards a successful implementation of the new Cargo Management System.
Deliver disruptive technology driven innovations that dramatically increase revenue or reduce cost.
Drive the insourcing strategy by recruiting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent, reducing reliance on vendor-driven delivery models.
Collaborate with Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, and Architects to define the product vision, architecture, and development roadmap.

Technology & Innovation
Oversee the delivery of robust, scalable, and secure digital applications, with a focus on performance, user experience, and maintainability.
Ensure modern engineering practices are followed, including Agile delivery, CI/CD automation, DevSecOps, test automation, and shift-left testing.
Champion the use and integration of Generative AI tooling and AI Agents within the development lifecycle to increase developer productivity and enable rapid iteration.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and assess their relevance and value for digital product development.
Foster a culture of engineering excellence through code quality, design standards, peer reviews, and continuous learning.

Execution & Delivery
Own end-to-end product delivery, from development through production deployment and support.
Collaborate closely with internal product managers, designers, architects, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely and high-quality product releases.
Monitor team performance, manage risks, remove delivery blockers, and drive accountability for outcomes.
Ensure proper technical documentation and knowledge-sharing across teams.

Collaboration & Communication
Partner cross-functionally with other IT and Digital leaders, including Architecture, Security, Data, and Infrastructure teams.
Engage with key business stakeholders across Digital, Marketing, Loyalty, and HR to ensure alignment between product features and business priorities.
Present technical strategies and delivery progress to senior leadership, contributing to enterprise-wide technology planning.

People & Budget Management
Manage operational and capital budgets, ensuring efficient resource allocation and delivery within financial targets.
Develop and maintain staffing plans, forecast resource needs, and align capacity to strategic priorities.
Support training and professional development programs to grow technical capabilities within the team.
Establish performance metrics and continuous improvement practices for team delivery and application performance.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
10+ years of experience in digital application development, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing front-end and back-end development teams.
Proven success in leading digital transformations, including insourcing and adoption of modern development frameworks and practices.
Deep technical expertise in web and mobile application development, microservices, cloud-native architecture, and API ecosystems.
Experience integrating AI/ML technologies or Generative AI into product development lifecycles is a strong asset.
Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD best practices.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across both business and technology teams.
Experience working in or with enterprise-scale organizations, ideally in travel, transportation, or customer experience-driven industries.
Demonstrate punctuality and dependability to support overall team success in a fast-paced environment.

Conditions Of Employment

Candidates must be eligible to work in the country of interest at the time any offer of employment is made and are responsible for obtaining any required work permits, visas, or other authorizations necessary for employment. Prior to their start date, candidates will also need to provide proof of their eligibility to work in the country of interest.

Linguistic Requirements

Based on equal qualifications, preference will be given to bilingual candidates.

Diversity and Inclusion

Air Canada is strongly committed to Diversity and Inclusion and aims to create a healthy, accessible and rewarding work environment which highlights employees’ unique contributions to our company’s success.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all to help us build a diverse workforce which reflects the diversity of our customers, and communities, in which we live and serve.

Air Canada thanks all candidates for their interest; however only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

jobs.description:
At SaskTel, big ideas come to life. We're a team of curious thinkers, bold innovators, and problem-solvers who make technology work better for people, businesses, and communities across Saskatchewan. Bring your energy, share your ideas, and help us shape what's next.

Director-Finance (Financial Planning & Dept Rel)

.

Type of Position:

GENERAL ACCOUNTABILITY

Accountable to the CFO for providing strategic financial information through the SaskTel Holdco five-year financial planning process, leading the development of the SaskTel Telco five-year financial plan together with the necessary controls and procedures to effectuate the plan. Accountable to work closely with all departments to facilitate planning, budgeting and forecasting.

SPECIFIC ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Lead and build the Financial Planning & Departmental Relationship team, ensuring that Finance is a proactive partner in SaskTel's business success. Contributes to optimum team performance by providing leadership and creating an environment encouraging motivation to achieve business goals and performance targets, providing for development of employees, fostering teamwork and providing recognition and feedback.
2. Responsible for providing strategic financial information through the five-year financial planning process to the SaskTel Executive and Board of Directors. Ensures that the financial plans for each of SaskTel’s subsidiaries and business units are aligned with the Holdco Strategic Plan, challenges and negotiates changes as required. Research and incorporate potential impacts of strategic opportunities/risks into SaskTel’s financial plans.
3. Accountable to facilitate the year end expectancy (YEE) for both net income & capital. Works with the subsidiaries and SaskTel Telco management to determine the YEE month. Communicates the YEE to the Executive, Board of Directors and CIC.
4. Leads the development of the SaskTel Telco five-year financial plan and budget, together with the necessary controls and procedures to effectuate the plan.
• Contributes to achieving the financial targets through integration of the budget cycle with the strategic planning process.
• Develops detailed financial and operational assumptions, negotiates department targets, identifies opportunities for change, and administers the processes required to compile revenue, expense and capital budgets.
• Accountable to analyze and communicate results and to take proactive action to improve competitive success, operations and financial performance, including responsibility for, capital, revenue and operating expense budgets, monthly variance analysis and explanations.
5. Accountable for systems and processes that ensure accurate, timely and effective information is forwarded and available to all areas of the business to support senior management decision making.
6. Responsible for ensuring that SaskTel Telco’s internal financial controls related to revenue, operating expenses and capital assets are up to date and effective.
7. Responsible for demonstrating commitment to service excellence and customer value with a bias to resolve customer issues and concerns in a timely manner.
8. Responsible for evaluating, challenging, and prioritizing capital investments to ensure an effective use of SaskTel’s financial and human resources. Facilitate the approval process through the Executive Capital Committee. Reflect any decisions in Corporate and Divisional capital and operating budgets.
9. Accountable for maintaining high levels of accuracy and timeliness ensuring compliance with CRTC directives and aligning inputs/results with regulatory strategy.
10. Accountable for Regulatory Reporting to ensure completion of all financial related CRTC filings including the telecommunications survey.
11. Accountable for CRTC Submissions including detailed analysis and adherence to CRTC Phase II Directives which includes cost studies and imputation tests for tariff filings, as well as all financial input required during any public process initiated by the CRTC
12. Accountable to minimize and mitigate exposure and impact to business-critical processes through the effective implementation of Business Continuity Plans and in accordance with responsibilities outlined in the Corporate BCM Policy, the Emergency Operations Procedures and the emergency Alert Procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS

1. Professional Accounting Designation (CPA).
2. Strong financial background in a managerial environment.
3. Several years’ experience dealing with corporate accounting, financial reporting, capital and operating budget processes within a holding company environment.
4. Ability to work effectively with senior management personnel.
5. Strong inter-personal and negotiation skills.
6. Ability and commitment to sharing appropriate information with internal and external bodies.
7. Solid comprehension of accounting theory and principles and ability to apply to new and existing processes. Understanding of international differences in IFRS and the impact on consolidated financial statement reporting is essential.
8. Knowledge of the telecommunications industry and SaskTel.
9. Ability to lead a group to maintain effectiveness in a changing environment.

CULTURE AND VALUES

Upholds foundational values of honesty, integrity and respect.
Consistently demonstrates our culture: Think Big (Innovation and Courage), Make a Difference (Commitment and Community), Focus on Experiences (Simplicity and Agility), and working as OneSaskTel Team.

This is an on-site position located at the location(s) above. The successful candidate must be located within the province of Saskatchewan. Out of province/country candidates must be willing to relocate. Flexible work opportunities, in province, may be available.

SaskTel may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help review and assess applications. All hiring decisions are made by qualified members of our recruitment team.

jobs.description:
Financial Lead, Office of the VP (Indigenous)

The University of Manitoba is a driving force of innovation, discovery and advancement. Our momentum is propelled by our campus community – UM faculty, staff and students whose determination and curiosity shape our world for the better. Our teaching, learning and work environment is uniquely strengthened and enriched by Indigenous perspectives. With two main campuses in Winnipeg, satellite campuses throughout Manitoba, and world-wide research, UM’s impact is global.
Discover outstanding employee benefits, experience world-class facilities and join a dynamic community that values reconciliation, sustainability, diversity, and inclusion. We are one of Manitoba’s Top Employers and one of Canada’s Best Diversity Employers. At the University of Manitoba, what inspires you can change everything.

The opportunity:

Reporting to the Vice-President (Indigenous), the Financial Lead provides strategic leadership and oversight of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource management for the Office of the Vice-President (Indigenous) and its reporting units. The role is responsible for the development and administration of operating budgets, financial analysis, accounting services, and expenditure planning, while providing expert advice to the Vice-President on fiscal priorities, resource allocation, and short- and long-term financial strategies.
The Financial Lead analyzes and monitors financial information from a variety of sources to support informed decision-making and ensure financial sustainability. This position oversees budgeting, forecasting, procurement, and financial management across all fund types, including operating, capital, research and grant, trust, and endowment funds. The incumbent works closely with reporting units to assess financial needs, validate expenditure projections, maintain balanced budgets, and support effective stewardship of resources.

The qualifications and experience we’re looking for:

Bachelors degree is required.
Professional designation in Accounting, CPA, is required.
A combination of relevant experience and/or training will be considered.
Five years’ experience in an accounting-related position directly related to executive administrative at a large institution such as a university, government department, private agency or foundation is required.
Experience with budgeting financial analysis, accounting and forecasting in a University environment is preferred.
Proficiency in MS Office, Aurora Finance and Concur are essential. A solid working knowledge of EPIC, Reach-UM, Aurora Student and VIP is required.
Must function with minimal supervision.
Must work effectively with others by establishing and maintaining positive collegial relations with colleagues, other university staff, and external partners.
Attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy is required.
Ability to make sound independent judgements and utilize problem solving abilities is required.
Ability to perform efficiently under pressure as a result of deadlines, etc. is required.
Ability to effectively and efficiently handle multiple, simultaneous, and complex tasks and projects is required.
Advanced verbal and written communication skills and the ability to communicate key elements of complex issues/processes in writing and verbally is required.
Ability to demonstrate tact and flexibility when dealing with potentially conflicting views and needs is required.
Satisfactory work record, including satisfactory attendance and punctuality, is required.

Along with being one of Manitoba’s top employers, we are proud to provide a collaborative and enriching work environment. In addition to a strong compensation package with a competitive salary, the University provides an exceptional workplace that includes:
Comprehensive group benefits and pension plan.
